title: Evidence přípravků na ochranu rostlin — ruční deník aplikací
description: Prepare distinct, reviewed application records using the national ÚKZÚZ record example published 30 March 2026. This is manual journal preparation, not a government file import or JUDPOR submission.

fields.label: Identifikace subjektu a adresa místa podnikání nebo sídla

sources.title: ÚKZÚZ — Evidence přípravků na ochranu rostlin: Příklad formátu vedení záznamů
sources.edition: Published 30 March 2026; DOCX internal revision 11; structural reading, pagination unverified

limitations: Partial source-backed manual record preparation. Not an authority upload, JUDPOR XML format, product authorization check or complete legal certification.
Each actual application is a separate reviewed operation UUID. Same-field, same-day applications are not collapsed into a farm/year answer.
LPIS, non-LPIS, forest and object identifiers must be supplied explicitly. A private field name or shared workspace permission establishes no official identity or mandate.
Original numeric text and units are retained. Area/scope uses two-decimal and dose three-decimal precision without silently rounding or converting; total product quantity is optional.
Efficacy and actual crop end may remain explicitly pending. Pending follow-up is not complete and must never become a fabricated date or ineffective result.
Sowing and crop-end dates do not apply to trees/forest stands. Source prose requires sown/planted land area, although the forest example table omits that column.
The example includes historical 2023/2024 values, not current product authorization or real-farm evidence. Original rendered layout and pagination are unverified.
The source describes distinct electronic transmission duties and XML-only ministry web services. No Annex 5 XML/XSD or authority acceptance contract is implemented here.
